profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Kohl’s
profile.summary: I am a passionate and skilled developer who enjoys creating innovative and scalable solutions for complex problems.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Defined and drove the technical vision for end-to-end observability and traceability across the centralized data access platform. Led the design and implementation of comprehensive distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics that provided full request visibility across service boundaries, significantly reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) production incidents while improving system reliability and operational excellence.
- Pioneered the integration of AI-driven query generation into the centralized data access platform, enabling consumers to generate efficient GraphQL queries using natural language input. This initiative improved developer experience, reduced the learning curve for GraphQL adoption, and increased productivity by allowing users to quickly translate business intent into optimized data-fetching queries.
positions.insights: Software Observability, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and +1 skill

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered and delivered a centralized data access platform serving multiple Kohl's Technology (KT) domains, enabling consistent, efficient, and scalable data retrieval through GraphQL. Designed the platform to support precise data fetching, reducing over-fetching while improving API performance and developer productivity.
- Led the introduction and adoption of gRPC across the centralized data access platform. Leveraged Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) to significantly reduce network payload size, improve serialization efficiency, and achieve low-latency, high-throughput inter-service communication for mission-critical workloads.
- Spearheaded a GraalVM Native Image proof of concept to evaluate next-generation runtime performance for Spring Boot services. Demonstrated substantial improvements in application startup time, making services more responsive during rapid auto-scaling events while reducing infrastructure overhead and improving operational efficiency.
- Introduced a cache-first architecture design across multiple dependent teams to optimize data retrieval patterns. Enabled significant reduction in end-to-end latency by prioritizing cached responses, minimizing redundant backend calls, and improving overall system responsiveness and scalability under high traffic conditions.
- Modernized a legacy Java-based routing service into a more maintainable, deployable, and supportable architecture. Used AI-assisted code analysis to understand undocumented legacy behavior, accelerate code comprehension, and create technical documentation, enabling the retirement of unsupported legacy IBM MQ integrations and reducing long-term operational and maintenance risk.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: - Collaborate in a remote team environment to design and build a new lending engine that provides the ability to deploy new products and add/update the business requirements for a product quickly.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Promoted to Staff Software Engineer
- Created a dynamic rule engine that validates loan data against underwriting credit policy. It simplifies validation rule management and provides product owners visibility into all validation rules. It also allows investors the ability to modify their own validation rules.
- Collaborated in a team environment to create the Digital Asset Registry Technologies (DART), a blockchain-based lien and eNote registry. Worked closely with Docutech to ensure smooth eNote integration which includes eNote data ingestion, validation, and blockchain contract execution.
- Collaborated with third party vendor to create a generic adapter for MISMO 3.4 data ingestion.
- Created a micro-service that integrates with Compliance Ease to analyze mortgage loan data.
- Joined the CSP (Customer Service Portal) team to learn about different Figure's products and services.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- In a Scrum team, design and build a new Browser Agent Client that will replace the existing Agent Client. This project uses Azure Devops and AWS infrastructure for Continuous Integration/Deployment (CI/CD), Phoenix Framework/Elixir for resiliency and scalability as a translation layer between old and new systems, and ReactJS for the frontend. 
- In a Scrum team, design and build a Single Sign-On solution for all existing products that uses AWS infrastructure for Continuous Integration/Deployment (CI/CD), AWS Lambda for processing requests, and VueJS for the frontend. 
- Promoted to Senior Software Engineer in 2016.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Design Patterns and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Promoted to Senior Software Development Engineer on November, 2016
- Apply Agile Methodology and collaborate with team members to fulfill new functionalities request from Project Managers/Customers over multiple Sprints for Spaces by Moxie product (http://www.gomoxie.com).
- Collaborate with a high performance team to deliver high-availability functionality to Email services as well as improved application performance by ~50% for email traffic I/O.
- Collaborate with a high performance team to convert email functionalities on legacy server (in C++) to a new server (in C# .NET 4.5) that utilizes: Repository Pattern, WCF Restful API, Entity Framework, Task Parallel Library, Task Dataflow, async and await, concurrent collections, Visual Studio unit testing, and Moq.
- Contribute to most Architectural Designs for existing and/or new features to deliver high quality product.
- Create coding guideline for the teams to improve product quality, performance, and code cohesiveness across all areas.
- Daily tasks include team discussions, researching, designing, and developing new features. Aiding Professional Services to handle customer escalations. Maintaining current and previous product versions.
- Daily tasks require programming language context switching between: C++/C# for server, SQL for database I/O, VB.NET/JavaScript for web U.I. administrator pages, and often Java for debugging Agent Client.
- Own and maintain core features of the product. This doesn’t limit the knowledge on other core features of the product.
- Contribute to all successful product releases including major versions, hotfixes, and patches.
- Recognized as engineer of the year in 2013.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Contractor w/ EnSoftek Inc.)
positions.description:
- Responsible for automated tests creation that enforce Windows Mobile Policies toward OEM/device manufacturers.
- Worked directly with policies owners to validate and brainstorm testing methodologies of their current policies.
- Developed several Windows and Windows Mobile platform tools for aiding the automated test creation process.
- Performed initial test execution to validate automated tests correctness.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Contractor w/ ComSYS IT)
positions.description:
- Contributed to the shipping of Forefront Endpoint Protection (FEP) and Forefront Protection Manager (FPM) Beta and Release Candidate 1.
- Involved in signing off procedures of various important DCRs.
- Developed tools using C++ and C# to verify structure correctness of policy files for Antimalware and Firewall sections.
- Verified stability of FEP & FPM Antimalware and Firewall by executing weekly manual test cases.
- Utilized WTT Studio to deploy various workflows and jobs for testing.
- Utilized Product Studio for bugs and DCRs management.
- Utilized System Kernel Debugger to investigate bugs that cause the machine to hang or malfunction.
- Worked closely with development teams to triage and verify bug fixes.
